description: Header file defining the InputLayoutCache class and related structures for caching Direct3D 11 input layouts in the ANGLE project.

classes.name: PackedAttributeLayout
classes.description: Structure representing a packed layout of vertex attributes for caching input layouts.

classes.name: InputLayoutCache
classes.description: Class responsible for creating, caching, and managing D3D11 input layouts.

methods.name: addAttributeData
methods.description: Adds attribute data to the PackedAttributeLayout.

methods.name: setCacheSize
methods.description: Sets the size of the cache for testing purposes.

methods.name: getInputLayout
methods.description: Retrieves or creates an input layout based on current state and attributes.

methods.name: createInputLayout
methods.description: Creates a new input layout given the context and attributes.
